valueProps.title: Three problems solved,
valueProps.item1Title: You find the product. We find the best price.
valueProps.item1Text: You no longer need to navigate 1688 or Taobao without understanding anything. Just send a photo or description, and we come back to you with the supplier's price, shipping fees, and total to pay — in FCFA or your local currency. Zero surprises, zero bad translations.
valueProps.item2Text: We accept payments via Mobile Money (Orange Money, Wave, MTN, Moov) and local transfers. We're the ones who handle payment to the Chinese supplier. You don't need an international bank account, or a Visa card. You pay the way you always pay.
valueProps.item3Text: We handle supplier verification, shipping from China, real-time tracking, and delivery to your address or country. You get photos and videos at every step. No more wondering "where's my order?" — we keep you informed all the way to delivery.

howItWorks.title: Three steps.
howItWorks.step1Text: Send us the photo or description of the product you want on WhatsApp. We analyze your request and get back to you within 24h with the exact price, delivery time, and order details.
howItWorks.step2Text: You approve the quote. You pay via Mobile Money or transfer — securely. As soon as payment is received, we place the order with the supplier and confirm it's underway.
howItWorks.step3Text: We handle everything: purchase, quality control, shipping, tracking and delivery to you. You get regular updates and your order arrives at your address in Africa.

testimonials.title: Merchants
testimonials.t1Text: I'd tried ordering on Alibaba on my own and lost 80,000 FCFA to a scam. With BizKey, I ordered 50 pairs of sneakers for my shop. I received everything in 3 weeks, exactly as shown in the photos. I recommend them without hesitation.
testimonials.t2Text: What convinced me was that they sent me photos of the product before shipping. I knew exactly what I was going to receive. I ordered refurbished phones and was able to triple my investment reselling them here in Dakar.
testimonials.t3Text: I didn't have a Visa card, I thought it was impossible to order from China. They accept Wave — I paid from my phone like I always do. My cosmetics order arrived in under a month.
testimonials.t4Text: I run a small accessories shop in Bamako. Before, a middleman took a big commission without ever showing the real prices. With BizKey, I see the supplier price directly and pay by Orange Money. My last order of 200 phone cases arrived complete.
testimonials.t5Text: I order in bulk for my fabric shop in Lomé. What changes everything is the tracking: I get videos of the packaging before shipping. On my last order of 300 meters, I saved nearly 15% compared to my old local supplier.
testimonials.t6Text: Between running my shop and answering customers on WhatsApp all day, I had no time left to source products. Since BizKey WhatsApp Assistant, frequent questions get answered automatically and I only deal with real orders. A real time-saver.
testimonials.t7Text: I've now ordered handbags for my online shop three times with BizKey. Every time, the tracking number actually works and I can tell my customers exactly when their order is arriving. That's what kept me coming back.

faq.q1: Is it reliable? How do I know it's not a scam?
faq.a1: We work in full transparency: you get the supplier's name, photos of the product before shipping, and a tracking number as soon as your order leaves China. We never ask for money before providing you with a detailed quote validated together.
faq.q2: How much does it cost to use your service?
faq.a2: We take a 5 to 10% commission on the total amount of your order (product + shipping). There are no hidden fees. Everything is shown in the quote before you confirm anything.
faq.q3: I don't have much capital. What's the minimum to place an order?
faq.a3: You can start with as little as 30,000 to 50,000 FCFA depending on the product. We help you identify suppliers who accept small quantities so you can test before ordering in bulk.
faq.q4: How long does delivery to Africa take?
faq.a4: Generally between 15 and 35 days depending on the country and shipping method chosen. We tell you the exact timeframe in the quote and keep you informed at every step.
faq.q5: Can I pay with Mobile Money?
faq.a5: Yes. Orange Money, Wave, MTN Mobile Money, Moov Money and T-Money are accepted depending on your country. No Visa card or international bank account is needed — you pay from your phone like you always do.
faq.q6: What happens if the product received doesn't match?
faq.a6: We inspect the goods before shipping and send you photos for validation. If, despite this, the delivered product doesn't match what was validated, we handle the dispute with the supplier and refund the affected portion.
